closure: Full author mathematical body retained. Complete Theorem4.1 construction/induction and all new weighted harmonic-mean multilinear, vector-field, Poisson-bracket, flow and homological core are retained. Source Hint-labelled illustrative examples are unselected; they are not used in the abstract normal-form construction. current_difficulty_reason: Finite-dimensional formal homological elimination does not control an infinite-dimensional Hamiltonian flow at energy regularity. Section3 proves harmonic-mean coefficient estimates and Poisson-bracket closure, including derivative bounds on both positive and negative Sobolev spaces. Section4 uses those new estimates in the degree-by-degree low-mode homological construction to obtain actual symplectic maps and a controlled remainder without demanding high-regularity initial data.
